```{r}

library(tidyverse)     # ecosystem of data science packages

library(janeaustenr)   # full texts for Jane Austen's 6 completed novels

library(wordcloud)     # for plotting word clouds
```

```{r}
pp_raw <- gutenberg_download(
  gutenberg_id = 1342,
  mirror = "https://aleph.pglaf.org/")

slice(pp_raw, 1:10)
```

Word or token: a single unit of text\
Tokenize or Tokenization: Decompose (break down) a text into individuals tokens.\
Bag-of-Words Analysis: this is perhaps the most basic type of text analysis based on counting frequencies of words or tokens.\

```{r}
# Reshaping text data into a table
pride_tbl = tibble("text" = prideprejudice)
pride_tbl
```

```{r}
pride_tokens = unnest_tokens(tbl = pride_tbl, input = text, output = word)
pride_tokens
```

```{r}
sentiments
```

```{r}
afinn |> slice_head(n = 8)
```

```{r}
pride_tokens

sentiments
```

```{r}
# attaching sentiments with inner_join
pride_sentim = inner_join(pride_tokens, sentiments, by = "word")

pride_sentim
```

```{r}
pride_sentim |> 
  count(word, sentiment, name = "count", sort = TRUE) |> 
  slice_head(n = 20) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = reorder(word, count), fill = sentiment)) +
  geom_col()
```

```{r}
# filter out "miss", and graph top-20 words
pride_sentim |> 
  count(word, sentiment, name = "count", sort = TRUE) |> 
  filter(word != "miss") |> slice_head(n = 20) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = reorder(word, count), fill = sentiment)) +
  geom_col()
```
